0022600222.text: The Lakers (10-2, 1st in the West and 1st in the Pacific) bring a six-game winning streak and an 8-2 record over their last ten into this 13th game of the season, and they are 5-1 on the road. The Bucks (1-10, 15th in the East) have lost seven straight and are 1-5 at home, and both teams are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions: Lakers guard Quentin Grimes, who is out with a finger injury and is averaging 8.0 points in 26.1 minutes this season, and Bucks guard Tyler Herro, who has a knee bruise. The two teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 105-101 Lakers loss in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026.
